answers.rationale: Kara repeatedly selects early-to-mid-afternoon Sunday returns when the program is over, avoiding both a morning airport start and a later evening arrival even when the later option is cheaper. The 1:55 p.m. flight is the established practical middle ground.

A mid-afternoon departure best matches Kara's repeated preference for a relaxed Sunday morning followed by a reasonably early evening at home. She consistently treats very early departures and later-evening arrivals as less desirable than this balanced timing, rather than choosing solely on fare.

For recovery weekends, Kara repeatedly favors an early-to-mid-afternoon Monday return that preserves a leisurely morning without creating a late home arrival. Here the available late checkout makes the 2:25 p.m. option especially practical; the 10:30 a.m. flight cuts the morning short, while 6:00 p.m. creates an overly long post-checkout gap and later arrival.

Kara's demonstrated default for an open post-event Sunday is an early-to-mid-afternoon return, paying a modest premium for a balanced day rather than taking a morning departure or stretching the return into the evening. The 2:15 p.m. nonstop best fits that pattern.
